name: motion-budget
title: Motion budget (still / lite / full)
summary: Decides once how much motion a device can afford, exposes it to JS (useMotionBudget) and CSS (rich:/lite:/still: variants).
when: The site has expensive optional effects (parallax, blur, cursor spotlights, video, continuous loops) that must not make a budget phone stutter.
next: Gate expensive effects: const { rich, animated } = useMotionBudget(); render the spotlight only when rich.
